flags.construct: Section header 'Function views of total relations (Lean-only)' (lsize … default_)
flags.issue: The header says the section restores 'a function view of each total one' and proves 'fun_<name>_<name>'. fzero does not fit that description. fun_fzero holds only for N = 32 and 64, so there is no fun_fzero_fzero; the lemmas are fun_fzero_32 and fun_fzero_64. The fzero docstring explains this, but the header does not. A minor point: the stated trigger ('every spec function whose body uses ! or indexing') does not describe $fzero, whose body POS (SUBNORM 0) uses neither but which is a relation with a wf_fN premise. $jsize, $lsizenn* and $default_ became relations because they call relations.
flags.suggestion: Add: 'fzero is the exception: its relation holds only at the widths 32 and 64 (fun_fzero_32, fun_fzero_64).' Optionally qualify the trigger, e.g. '... uses ! or indexing, directly or through another such function (fzero: through the wf side condition of its result)'.
